name: compute validated molecular descriptors with exact typed fields
definition: From a molecular object compute the ADMET-style properties (LogP, MW, H-bond donor/acceptor counts, rotatable bonds, TPSA) with the correct python datatypes.
failure_mode: Wrong types or hard-coded values that deviate from the toolkit's real results.

name: convert a transcript into the ordered user-typed commands
definition: Extract the presented verb-phrase commands the player entered along the gameplay while preserving order.
failure_mode: Spelling or ordering drift below threshold fails similarity.

name: convert wavelength scale to wavenumber units
definition: Apply the reciprocal conversion from wavelength to wavenumber so peak positions land on the expected spectroscopic axis.
failure_mode: Omitting the scale conversion puts peaks at the wrong locations and fails the center tolerance.

name: correct scripting issues such as shebang and line endings
definition: Ensure scripts have a valid interpreter directive and no carriage-return line endings.
failure_mode: Bad shebang or CRLF bytes fail the content checks.
